prereq.description: Space-separated list of init-bottom script names that must complete before this hook runs; controls initramfs execution order

run_interfaces_dir.description: Directory where the generated ifupdown interface snippet is written; must be on a tmpfs that survives pivot_root into the real root

dhcp_timeout.description: Seconds the DHCP client waits for a lease before giving up; reduce on fast LANs, increase on slow or congested networks

interface_metric.description: Route metric assigned to the PXE boot interface; set higher than cloud-init managed interfaces to deprioritise it once fully booted

dhcp4.description: Write an 'inet dhcp' stanza so the resolved boot interface acquires an IPv4 address via DHCP

dhcp6.description: Append an 'inet6 dhcp' stanza to request an IPv6 address via DHCPv6 on the boot interface

fallback_interface.description: Interface name to configure when no BOOTIF kernel parameter is present; leave empty to skip configuration entirely on non-PXE boots

dhcp4_options.description: Extra ifupdown key-value options appended under the 'inet dhcp' stanza (e.g. hostname, dns-nameservers, dns-search)

key.description: ifupdown option name as it appears in an interfaces(5) stanza

value.description: Option value written verbatim into the snippet

description.description: Inline comment that appears above the option line in the generated snippet
